title: a generic enum case infers T from payloads that need an expected type: loop/last, else, reduce, nested cases
purpose: Observe that an uninferred type parameter is not imposed as an expected type on a payload (#304).

provenance.origin: authored for #304 from the Book (24.1, 25.2) and the owner's decision
provenance.expected_basis: Book 24.1: T is inferred from the arguments; the payloads evaluate to 42, 7 and 0+1+2 = 3, then 5, 1*10+2 = 12 and a two-element list, then 3 and 4.
